channel.title: 8 Out of 10 Cats Does Countdown
channel.description: Jimmy Carr hosts an anarchic comedy game-show mash-up of 8 Out of 10 Cats and Countdown, with Rachel Riley and Susie Dent as comedians take on the numbers, letters and conundrum rounds.
